title: About the Costume System
summary: An introduction to the NEED server's Costume Album, Wardrobe and Enchant Stone systems.

blocks.title: Costume Collection
blocks.text: Over 2,000 costumes are registered so far, and new costumes will keep being added.

items: Register it in the Costume Album.
A registered costume is stored permanently in the Costume Album.
The original costume item is used up when you register it.
To wear it later, you receive it as a rental, and it becomes a character-bound costume.
The character that registered it first can use the costume right away.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: If you register several costumes for the same slot, only the last one registered is delivered to your inventory. The earlier ones are still saved in the album: store them in the Wardrobe and take them out when you need them.
Registered costumes can be unlocked for your account so that your other characters can use them too.

rows: Usable by every character on the same account

blocks.text: Expand the Wardrobe's slots to store more costumes.

rows: 1,000,000 Zeny for the first, rising with each expansion

blocks.text: Keep collecting costumes to earn extra rewards: 100 costumes registered = 30 Costume Coins.
Enchant Stones can also be registered for permanent use.

items: Enchant Stones are registered per character.
A registered stone applies permanently to that character.
A registered costume you take out comes with the enchant already applied.
Registered enchants stay even if you change the costume or take it out again.
Enchant Stones are not shared with other characters on the same account.

blocks.text: The collection exchange lets you get the costume you want directly.

rows: Choose 1 costume by its album number

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: New costumes and Enchant Stones will be added step by step with server updates and the roadmap.
